text: Ever been on a date and a girl asks you a question and you are not sure if it's some kind of test? Yeah, that's exactly what we're talking about today. Here are three tricky questions women often throw at you on a date and how to handle them without losing points. Number one. She asks, how come a guy like you is still single? Most men panic and start over explaining. Oh, I tried dating, but you know, it's hard for a man, blah, blah, blah. Big mistake. That makes you sound unwanted. The better answer? Say with a smile something like, I guess I just haven't met the right person yet. Who knows? Maybe I'm a bit selective. That frames you as a chooser, not the rejected one. Number two. She says, you must be really busy, right? Don't say, nah, I just work and watch Netflix. That screams boring. Instead, show that your life is full and you choose where to put your time. Yeah, I've got a lot going on. Work, sports, friends. But when I meet someone I enjoy, I always make time. That makes you sound interesting and in control. Number three. When you flirt with her, she asks, does this usually work on other girls? Most guys freeze here. Don't. Keep eye contact, smile, and answer playfully. On the prettiest girls? Always. How about we test it? Then go for the kiss. Remember, these questions are like mini tests. And if you answer with confidence and fun, you pass every single time.
